description: Elixir raises ArgumentError for a runtime quote(do: unquote([1 | 2])), because an improper list is not valid quoted code. fz returns [1 | 2] on interp, run and build. The macro-expansion path already refuses it with macro/invalid-quoted-expr (src/compiler2/quoted_expander.rs:1268 and :2054); only the runtime quote path lets it through. Probes: Bugs and Cleanup scratchpad s22/r3/p/q*.fz. Proposed by Bugs and Cleanup; filed with user approval 2026-11-24.
title: A runtime quote(do: unquote([1 | 2])) raises ArgumentError, as in Elixir
